description: This file contains the implementation of the TwitterOAuth class, which provides methods for handling OAuth authentication with Twitter's REST API, including obtaining request tokens, access tokens, and signing requests.

classes.name: TwitterOAuth
classes.description: A class to facilitate OAuth authentication and interaction with Twitter's REST API.

methods.name: accessTokenURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining an access token.

methods.name: authenticateURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for Twitter's authenticate endpoint.

methods.name: authorizeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for Twitter's authorize endpoint.

methods.name: requestTokenURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for requesting a request token.

methods.name: lastStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP status code received.

methods.name: lastAPICall
methods.description: Returns the last API call made.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TwitterOAuth class with consumer key/secret and optional token.

methods.name: getRequestToken
methods.description: Requests a request token from Twitter.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for user authorization.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Exchanges a request token and verifier for an access token.

methods.name: getXAuthToken
methods.description: Performs a one-time exchange of username and password for an access token.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to Twitter API.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to Twitter API.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to Twitter API.

methods.name: oAuthRequest
methods.description: Prepares and signs an OAuth request.

methods.name: http
methods.description: Executes an HTTP request using cURL.
